title: Context Has a Price: Adding and Removing Context for LLM Coding Agents under Prefix Caching
abstract: arXiv:2611.22238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents repeatedly send their conversation history to a language model. Adding useful code may reduce search, while removing old tool outputs may shorten later prompts. But do these changes reduce the cost of solving a task? We study this as a measurement problem in more than 20,000 runs of open models on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench and Loc-Bench. We account separately for uncached input, cached input and output tokens. Three findings emerge. First, in our main evidence-package experiments, retrieved code reduces read and search commands by 18--34%, but increases cost by 33--42% when cached input costs one tenth of uncached input, without a measurable improvement in resolution. Second, removing old observations can either save money or increase cost: the same approach saves 19--36% without a cache discount but increases cost by 38--116% with a tenth-price cache. Third, shorter prompts do not guarantee cheaper runs because agents

translated_title: 上下文有代价：前缀缓存下为LLM编程智能体添加与删除上下文
translated_abstract: 编程智能体会将其对话历史反复发送给语言模型。添加有用的代码可能减少搜索工作，而删除旧的工具输出可能缩短后续提示词。但这些改变是否真的能降低解决任务的成本？我们在SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench和Loc-Bench上对开源模型进行了超过20,000次运行，将此作为一个测量问题加以研究。我们分别统计未缓存的输入token、缓存的输入token和输出token。研究得出三个发现。第一，在我们主要的证据包实验中，检索到的代码将读取和搜索类命令减少了18–34%，但当缓存输入价格为未缓存输入的十分之一时，总成本反而增加了33–42%，且任务解决率没有可测量的提升。第二，删除旧的观察结果既可能省钱也可能增加成本：同样的方法在没有缓存折扣时可节省19–36%的成本，但在十分之一价格的缓存下却使成本增加38–116%。第三，更短的提示词并不能保证更便宜的运行，因为智能体……
tldr: 本文通过超过2万次实测发现，在前缀缓存定价机制下，为LLM编程智能体添加检索代码或删除旧观察结果并不必然省钱——同一策略在不同缓存折扣下可能节省19–36%也可能增加38–116%的成本，且更短的提示词并不能保证更便宜的运行。
en_tdlr: Through over 20,000 measured runs, this paper shows that under prefix-caching prices, adding retrieved code or removing old observations for LLM coding agents does not reliably reduce cost—the same strategy can save 19–36% or increase cost by 38–116% depending on cache discounts, and shorter prompts do not guarantee cheaper runs.
